heading.en: What do whales, bats and you have in common?

hook.en: A whale's flipper, a bat's wing and your arm do very different jobs, yet the same bones are inside all three. That is a clue to common ancestry.
hook.kn: ತಿಮಿಂಗಿಲದ ಈಜುರೆಕ್ಕೆ, ಬಾವಲಿಯ ರೆಕ್ಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಮ್ಮ ತೋಳು ಬೇರೆ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ, ಆದರೆ ಒಳಗಿನ ಮೂಳೆಗಳು ಒಂದೇ.

narration.en: A whale's flipper, a bat's wing and your arm do very different jobs, yet the same bones are inside all three. That is a clue to common ancestry.

body.en: Fossils are remains of hard parts of life forms found in rocks; deeper sedimentary layers hold older life forms, and their age is found by radioactive dating. Homologous organs have the same structure and origin but different functions: forelimbs of whales, bats, cheetahs and humans; the vertebrate heart and brain; thorns of Bougainvillea and tendrils of Cucurbita. They show divergent evolution. Analogous organs look alike and do similar work but have different structures: wings of butterflies and birds, eyes of the octopus and mammals, flippers of penguins and dolphins, sweet potato (root) and potato (stem). They show convergent evolution.
body.kn: ಜೀವಾಶ್ಮಗಳು ಶಿಲೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿನ ಜೀವಿಗಳ ಅವಶೇಷಗಳು. ಸಮರೂಪ ಅಂಗಗಳು ರಚನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದೇ, ಕಾರ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಬೇರೆ: ಅಪಸರಣ ವಿಕಾಸ. ಸಮಾನ ಕಾರ್ಯ ಅಂಗಗಳು ಕಾರ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದೇ, ರಚನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬೇರೆ: ಅಭಿಸರಣ ವಿಕಾಸ.

points.en: Homologous: same structure, different function → divergent evolution
Analogous: same function, different structure → convergent evolution

say.en: The forelimbs of a human, a bat and a whale do very different jobs but have the same bones: humerus, radius and ulna, carpals and digits.
Homologous organs share origin but differ in function: divergent evolution. Analogous organs do similar work with different structures: convergent evolution.
Industrial melanism: before 1850, white moths hid on lichen-covered trunks. Soot killed the lichens and darkened the trunks, so dark moths escaped birds and became common.

body.en: In England, before industrialisation (around 1850), white-winged moths were more common on trees covered with white lichen. After industrialisation, soot darkened the tree trunks and killed the lichens, so dark-winged moths were better camouflaged and became more common: industrial melanism. Excess use of herbicides and pesticides has selected resistant varieties in a short time, and antibiotics have selected resistant microbes. These are examples of evolution by anthropogenic action.
body.kn: ಇಂಗ್ಲೆಂಡ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೈಗಾರಿಕೀಕರಣದ ನಂತರ ಕಪ್ಪು ಪತಂಗಗಳು ಹೆಚ್ಚಾದವು: ಕೈಗಾರಿಕಾ ಕೃಷ್ಣತೆ. ಕೀಟನಾಶಕ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರತಿಜೀವಕ ನಿರೋಧಕತೆ ಮಾನವ ಚಟುವಟಿಕೆಯಿಂದ ಆಗುವ ವಿಕಾಸದ ಉದಾಹರಣೆಗಳು.

caption.en: Radioactive dating: the amount of a radioactive isotope halves every half-life. Set the half-life and the percentage still left in a fossil to find its age.

tryThis.en: Carbon-14 has a half-life of about 5730 years. If 25% is left, how old is the fossil?
If 12.5% is left, how many half-lives have passed?
Why would carbon-14 be useless for a 50-million-year-old dinosaur bone?

problem.en: Classify as homologous or analogous: (a) thorn of Bougainvillea and tendril of Cucurbita, (b) wings of a butterfly and a bird, (c) potato and sweet potato.

steps.en: (a) Both are modified stem structures with the same origin but different functions: homologous.
(b) Both are for flight but have completely different structures: analogous.
(c) Both store food, but potato is a stem and sweet potato a root: analogous.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Classify as homologous or analogous: (a) thorn of Bougainvillea and tendril of Cucurbita, (b) wings of a butterfly and a bird, (c) potato and sweet potato.

body.en: HOMologous = same HOMe (origin), different jobs. ANAlogous = ANother origin, same job.
